title: Standalone Model Parameters Create Request
description: POST /api/v1/model-parameters — the STANDALONE model-parameters create route (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:92 `create_model_parameters`, blueprint url_prefix `/model-parameters` registered under /api/v1 by src/routes/api_v1.py:121). Distinct from agents/model_parameters_create_request_schema.json (POST /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/model-parameters): this route takes a camelCase `modelParameters` ARRAY and names its owning agent in the body, because ModelParameters carries no tenant/project column and the agent association is its only ownership record (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:210-239). Numeric bounds are enforced by `validate_model_parameter_bounds` reading THIS repo's agents/model_parameters_schema.json (snake_case) with camelCase field labels (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:169-188), so the bounds below mirror that file. additionalProperties:true — the handler reads only the keys named here and ignores the rest.

modelParameters.description: Non-empty array of parameter entries. A missing/non-array/empty value is rejected with a BARE 400 `{error}` body (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:114-117), not the canonical envelope.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. The handler rejects a non-integral number such as 1000.5 (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:59-71).

agentId.description: Id of the owning agent. Bounded by the AGENT_ID_MAX_LENGTH column width (TraigentBackend src/models/agent.py:13 `AGENT_ID_MAX_LENGTH = 512`). REQUIRED: the handler returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when it is absent or blank, because a ModelParameters row with no agent association is attributable to nobody (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:240-248). Resolved through the owner-scoped AgentDAL, so a foreign or unknown id yields a non-disclosing 404.

modelId.description: Optional LLM model identifier. When absent the handler resolves or creates a default catalog row; when present-but-unknown it creates a lightweight stub row (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:263-277). NOTE: unlike POST /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/model-parameters after TraigentBackend#3347, this route does NOT reject an unresolvable modelId.
